rule: Every figure here is a published list price or statistic, read from its primary page on the date given. The cost case multiplies them by the buyer's own volumes and figures. None of it is a price for break-it, which is MIT-licensed with no licence fee.

sources.what: AWS WAF: a web ACL $5.00 a month, a rule $1.00 a month, $0.60 per million requests (up to the default 1,500 WCUs; more WCUs add $0.20 per million for each 500)
sources.quote: Request charges = $0.60/million * 10 million = $6.00 (the page's Case A: one web ACL, 19 rules, 10 million requests = $30.00)

sources.what: Amazon API Gateway: REST APIs $3.50 per million for the first 333 million, $2.80 for the next 667 million, $2.38 after that; HTTP APIs $1.00 per million for the first 300 million, $0.90 after that
sources.quote: The tiers are read from the page's own worked examples (REST: 15 billion requests in US East; HTTP: 432 million). The calculator stops at 15 billion requests a month, the largest volume the page works through.

sources.what: Ofgem price cap, electricity, direct debit, Great Britain average, 1 October to 31 December 2026: 26.32p per kWh (standing charge 54.83p a day, paid whether a node runs or not, so it is left out)
sources.quote: There is no VAT on electricity from 1 October 2026 to 31 March 2027.

sources.what: Intel Core i7-1255U, the laptop chip the pilot ran on: Processor Base Power 15 W, Maximum Turbo Power 55 W. The cost case uses 55 W, the most the chip can draw, so it never understates the node's electricity
Bank of England series XUDLUSS, spot exchange rate, US $ into sterling, 22 October 2026: 1.3363
IBM and Ponemon Institute, Cost of a Data Breach Report 2026: the global average cost of a data breach is USD 4.99 million
sources.quote: The global average cost of a data breach, in USD: 4.99M
